title: Late dark symmetry breaking activates daughter-only quintessence coupling
assumptions: Complex charged parent A and neutral real daughter B with H2† A B^2 gauge-invariant operator; H2 obtains a prescribed late VEV.
After A to 2B conversion only B has chi-dependent mass; the analyzed homogeneous equations treat A/B as pressureless matter apart from the mass-transfer term.
Decay onset and rapid rate, daughter kinematics, neglected radial-mode energy and the trigger completion are assumed rather than observationally qualified.
predictions: Before daughter production, the chosen matter-quintessence interaction is absent; after activation energy transfers from B to chi through -c_tilde chi_dot rho_B.
Summing the displayed A/B continuity equations and chi energy equation cancels decay and coupling source terms, yielding total homogeneous energy conservation in the retained sectors.
Delayed daughter coupling can reduce early interaction exposure; the paper does not compute fifth-force or perturbation bounds.
